title: PLADOS: A Parameter-free Landing Algorithm for Decentralized Optimization on the Stiefel Manifold
summary: Decentralized optimization on the Stiefel manifold has broad applications in machine learning and signal processing. We propose PLADOS, a parameter-free landing algorithm for decentralized optimization on the Stiefel manifold. Each iteration combines local stochastic gradient updates with a single retraction-free communication step over the communication graph. A key convex-like property of the intersection of the nonconvex Stiefel manifold and consensus constraints is characterized through a restricted secant inequality for the penalty-only scheme, ensuring local contraction of the manifold…
